nodes.label: Earth Night Texture
nodes.description: A 4096x2048 equirectangular (2:1) satellite-style texture map of Earth at night, in the style of NASA's 'Black Marble' / Earth-at-night composites. Continents are rendered in dark navy blue against deep blue-black oceans, with clusters of warm yellow-orange city lights marking urban areas — dense across the eastern United States, Europe, India, East Asia, and coastal South America and Australia. The equirectangular projection makes it suitable for wrapping onto a 3D sphere; in this project it serves as the globe surface texture for the react-globe.gl world-news globe app, giving the interactive news globe its dark nighttime aesthetic.
